history.segment_definition_changes: Starting from the second quarter of 2022, Meituan reorganized its segment reporting structure from three segments (Food delivery, In-store, hotel and travel, and New initiatives and others) into two reportable operating segments: Core Local Commerce (combining food delivery, in-store, hotel and travel, Meituan Instashopping, alternative accommodations, and transportation ticketing) and New Initiatives (including Meituan Select, Xiaoxiang Supermarket / Meituan Grocery, Kuailv B2B food distribution, ride sharing, bike sharing, power banks, micro-credit, and other new businesses). Segment figures for FY2021 were restated by the company under this two-segment structure.

history.segment_definition_changes: Prior to Q2 2024, Xiaomi reported four operating segments: Smartphones, IoT and lifestyle products, Internet services, and Others. Starting in Q2 2024, following the commercial launch of its EV business, the Group reorganized into two main reportable segments: (1) Smartphone × AIoT (comprising Smartphones, IoT and lifestyle products, Internet services, and Other related businesses), and (2) Smart EV and other new initiatives. In Q1 2025, the segment was updated to 'Smart EV, AI and other new initiatives'. The company evaluates segment performance based on segment revenue and gross profit.

division_ebitda.notes: In its annual reports and annual results announcements, CITIC Limited (00267.HK) does not report or disclose EBITDA for its business segments or operating divisions. The five reportable operating segments defined and reported by CITIC Limited under HKFRS 8 are Comprehensive Financial Services, Advanced Intelligent Manufacturing, Advanced Materials, New Consumption, and New-Type Urbanisation, and the measure used for reporting segment profit is 'profit for the year' rather than EBITDA. Furthermore, neither 'CITIC Mining / Resources' nor 'Advanced Materials & Manufacturing' are reported as standalone divisions with disclosed EBITDA. In accordance with the instructions, divisions without disclosed EBITDA are omitted.

history.segment_definition_changes: With effect from 1 January 2024, Hutchison Asia Telecommunications (previously presented under the Telecommunications division / as a separate reportable segment) was reclassified and integrated into the Finance & Investments and Others segment. The comparative figures for FY2023 were restated accordingly in the FY2024 Annual Report and FY2025 results announcement. Prior to this reorganisation, Hutchison Asia Telecommunications was reported as a separate reportable segment in FY2021 and FY2022 (and originally in FY2023). Figures are presented on a Post-IFRS 16 basis and include the Group's proportionate share of associated companies and joint ventures, consistent with the Group's primary segment presentation (Analyses by Core Business Segments).

division_ebitda.notes: Figures are taken from CK Hutchison Holdings Limited's 2025 Annual Results Announcement for the year ended 31 December 2025. Per the Group's segment reporting policy, reported segment revenue, EBITDA, and EBIT include the Group's proportionate share of associated companies and joint ventures. In Note 6(b)(xiii), segment EBITDA before one-off items is broken down into Company & Subsidiaries and Associates & Joint Ventures: Ports & Related Services total HK$17,439 million (HK$13,320 million from subsidiaries, HK$4,119 million from associates/JVs); Retail total HK$18,238 million (HK$12,414 million from subsidiaries, HK$5,824 million from associates/JVs); and 3 Group Europe total HK$25,877 million (HK$20,425 million from subsidiaries, HK$5,452 million from associates/JVs). Management's discussion is presented on a Pre-IFRS 16 basis; on a Post-IFRS 16 basis, FY2025 EBITDA is HK$20,424 million for Ports & Related Services and HK$27,909 million for Retail.

history.segment_definition_changes: In 2024, the business segment reporting was re-organised to give greater clarity and add emphasis to the Group's focused markets of Indonesia and Vietnam. Within Indonesia and Vietnam, Astra, THACO, and REE are identified operating segments, while Regional Interests represents the Group's collective businesses outside Indonesia and Vietnam (including the Cycle & Carriage motor businesses in Singapore and Malaysia). Prior to 2024, the reportable segments were Astra, Direct Motor Interests, Other Strategic Interests (and THACO). Under the segment note (Note 17), only Astra and Regional Interests (previously Direct Motor Interests) generate consolidated revenue, as THACO and REE are equity-accounted associates. Comparative figures for FY2023 were restated under the new segment structure, whereas FY2021 and FY2022 were not restated.

history.segment_definition_changes: EXCO considers that the Group's operations constitute a single segment in the business of investment holding across Singapore, India, Hong Kong, and the Cayman Islands. In FY2022, following a significant reduction in the Group's management and consultancy services business, the Group began managing the investment holding and management and consultancy service businesses as one operating segment ('Investment holding'), and prior year comparatives (FY2021) were reclassified accordingly. Segment revenue is derived from dividend income and distributions from financial assets at FVOCI (such as HKT), and does not include the company's share of results of associates and joint ventures (such as PCCW Limited), which is accounted for under the equity method and presented separately as 'Share of (loss)/profit of associated corporations, net of tax'.

history.segment_definition_changes: Under the Re-organisation Plan announced in January 2020, Olam restructured its business into three distinct operating groups: Olam Food Ingredients (ofi), Olam Agri, and Remaining Olam Group. During 2021 and 2022, the Coffee plantation business was transferred from Remaining Olam Group to ofi, while ofi's Russian operations (primarily Rusmolco) were transferred from ofi to Remaining Olam Group; prior periods were restated accordingly. In 2025, following shareholder approval for the sale of Olam Agri to SALIC, Olam Agri (excluding certain entities retained by Olam Group) was classified as a disposal group held for sale and defined as 'Olam Agri (Discontinuing Operations)', with Retained Entities included under Remaining Olam Group and FY2024 comparatives re-presented accordingly.

From 1 April 2025 (FY2025/26), SingPost restructured its business and segment reporting into three key business segments: Logistics & Letters, Post Office Network, and Property Assets (replacing the previous market-based segmentation). Segment revenues and results for the comparative prior year ended 31 March 2025 (FY2024/25) were restated accordingly, and continuing operations excluded the divested Australia business and freight forwarding operations reclassified under discontinued operations. For earlier fiscal years (FY2021/22, FY2022/23, and FY2023/24), the reportable business segments were Post and Parcel, Logistics, and Property.

Under HKFRS 8, the executive directors of Geely Automobile Holdings Limited (the chief operating decision maker) manage and review the performance of the Group's operations on a consolidated basis as a single operating segment (all activities relating to the production and sales of automobiles, automobile parts and components, collaborative manufacturing services, and research and development services and licence income share similar economic characteristics). Consequently, no separate analysis of segment results by reportable segment is presented, and no segment profit measure is reported. Prior to the completion of the acquisition and consolidation under common control of LYNK & CO in February 2025, FY2024 revenue was originally reported as RMB 240,194,270 thousand; it was subsequently restated to RMB 275,910,484 thousand in the FY2025 financial statements.

history.segment_definition_changes: WH Group operates and reports three primary segments: Packaged meats, Pork, and Others. There have been no resegmentations or changes in segment definitions over the 5-year period (FY2021–FY2025). Reported segment revenue represents external sales and excludes inter-segment revenue. Segment revenue does not include the company's share of profits/losses of associates and joint ventures; these items are reported separately below reportable segment profit in the reconciliation to consolidated profit before tax.
